quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on reaching 10,000 career points milestone
quotes.excerpt: It's a testament to a lot of hard work and just a lot of patience
quotes.quote: There's really no words for it. It's a testament to a lot of hard work and just a lot of patience and just me being myself. There's no question I've been struggling a bit to start the season, but to have a breakthrough like tonight was really big for my confidence and just a reminder of who I am in this league and what my strengths are.
quotes.social_post: Myles Turner on hitting 10,000 career points: There is really no words for it. It is a testament to a lot of hard work and just a lot of patience and just me being myself.

structured.context: Myles Turner reflects on reaching the 10,000 career points milestone after a challenging start to the season.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on the team's collective breakthrough and recent play
quotes.excerpt: It's been a group breakthrough that's been on the way too.
quotes.quote: It's been a group breakthrough that's been on the way too. I feel like for the past two to three weeks we've been playing basketball the right way. Sometimes a couple plays didn't go our way in the past few games, but we finally collectively fought and put four quarters of basketball together. We just can't be satisfied. I think that we finally set a good precedent for ourselves, now it's to keep rolling.
quotes.social_post: Myles Turner says the team is finally playing basketball the right way after a recent slump: We finally collectively fought and put four quarters of basketball together. We just cannot be satisfied.

structured.context: Myles Turner discusses the team finally playing well and putting together a complete four-quarter performance.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on mentoring young players like Nate and Braden
quotes.excerpt: I take immense pride being a leader on this team.
quotes.quote: I take immense pride being a leader on this team. Obviously, the results haven't been exactly what we wanted, but the process hasn't changed. I feel like that's my biggest message to everybody on this team is the day-to-day process, how you impact winning, how you impact the organization, how to be a pro. Those guys, they exemplify it between Nate and Braden. Their futures are very bright in this league and they have grown game by game. It's such a blessing in your rookie year to be able to get in-game experience so early.
quotes.social_post: Myles Turner on mentoring rookies Nate and Braden: I take immense pride being a leader on this team. Their futures are very bright in this league and they have grown game by game.

structured.context: Myles Turner discusses his role as a leader and mentor to young teammates Nate and Braden.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on the importance of winning on the road
quotes.excerpt: Winning is very hard in this league, no matter what team you're on.
quotes.quote: Winning is very hard in this league, no matter what team you're on, no matter what schemes you run, no matter how long you've been in this league. You don't take winning for granted. It's been damn near a month since we won a game, so a night like tonight, you celebrate it. We know we're back to work tomorrow, but you enjoy this feeling. You go to sleep a little bit lighter tonight, knowing that you handled business, especially on the road.
quotes.social_post: Myles Turner on snapping a month long losing streak: Winning is very hard in this league. You do not take winning for granted. It has been damn near a month since we won a game, so a night like tonight, you celebrate it.

structured.context: Myles Turner comments on the importance of securing a road victory after a long winless streak.

quotes.speaker: Myles Turner
quotes.summary_phrase: Myles Turner on team chemistry and defensive impact
quotes.excerpt: Defensively is where you got to really really make impact in this league.
quotes.quote: We have more veterans in the starting group, so I feel like our roles are a little more defined. It took some chemistry to begin the year to figure out exactly how we want to play together, but it's coming together. I think really the biggest thing is defensively. I think that's where we know we have talent to get the scores on this team, but defensively is where you got to really really make impact in this league, especially now where offense is really precipitous of everything that teams are doing. There's plenty of guys, Kelel, he's really starting to come together because he's understanding that he impacts the game in so many more ways than just scoring.
quotes.social_post: Myles Turner says the key to the team finding their rhythm is defense: Defensively is where you have to really make impact in this league, especially now where offense is really precipitous of everything that teams are doing.

structured.context: Myles Turner explains how the team is developing chemistry and focusing on defensive impact, specifically highlighting Kelel.
